receipt_note: Each record carries the observed exit_code of the actual process with its literal command and cwd, and its retained log under logs/candidate/. expected_exit is the outcome the run was meant to produce: single-file translations of float-bearing crates are expected to refuse (Aeneas exits 2 on a raised translation error), Lean cells without any external module are expected to fail on the missing module, and the f32 crate with the pilot model placed is expected to fail because the reviewed model defines only F64. Template-as-is cells pass because the template declares each float as an axiom placeholder, the same shape it uses for opaque types; admitting an unfilled template is the consumer decision, which the consumer patch refuses through the existing template check. No timing fields.
